title: Area minimality under compactly supported deformations forces the first variation to vanish (Simon Ch. 2, 5.1–5.3; parent steps 0c and 1)
statement: Deformation-minimal C¹ submanifolds are stationary. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: U is open; M ⊆ U; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; and for every C^∞ map Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport Z ⊆ U there is t₀ > 0 such that H^m(M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ H^m({x + tZ(x) : x ∈ M ∩ tsupport Z}) for every t with |t| < t₀. Conclusion: for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ U, ∫_M div_M X dH^m = 0, where div_M X(x) := trace(P_x∘DX(x)), P_x is the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto span(tangentSpace M x) (starProjection), DX(x) = fderiv ℝ X x, and the integral is the Bochner integral over M with respect to H^m = μHE[m].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → tsupport Z ⊆ U → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))) → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0
